error[ZBX-E0203]: can't create the container's namespaces
  while  starting container web-1
  cause  clone3 with new user, mount, PID, UTS and IPC namespaces failed:
         permission denied (EACCES)
  cause  the kernel or a security policy refused to create the namespaces for
         this process
  cause  this host restricts unprivileged user namespaces through AppArmor
         (kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns = 1)
  name   web-1
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   spawn (2 of 43)
  fix    allow them system-wide:        sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
         keep it after a reboot:        echo 'kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns = 0' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-zigbox-userns.conf
         check this host (ZBX-E0101):   zbx doctor
  more   zbx explain E0203
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0203.html
